rows.text: Jordan's standing rule: test changes end to end in the running app before opening a PR, not only unit tests, and say what was checked. Reason: a date picker change passed unit tests but was broken in the real browser.

Invoice due dates in the acme web app are shown in the viewer's browser timezone (Intl.DateTimeFormat, no explicit timeZone) via formatDueDate in apps/web/lib/dates.ts, because some users are in Vancouver and UTC showed the wrong day.

Gotcha: the acme API invoice endpoint only includes lineItems when the request passes expand=lineItems. The cached list row has no lineItems, so invoice detail can see invoice.lineItems undefined and crash on .map. A real fix (always request expand=lineItems in the detail query) was proposed but not confirmed.

acme-platform pins Node 20.11 in .nvmrc (moved off Node 18 on 2026-08-27, commit b71c0de); package.json engines is >=20.11 <21. Run `nvm install` once then `nvm use` before installing dependencies, otherwise install fails with an engines error (Jordan's new laptop had Node 18.20.4).

Jordan's rule: never run long benchmarks on the shared CI runners (they slow everyone down); run benchmarks locally. Do not add the PDF render bench as a CI job. It is local-only: services/worker/scripts/bench-pdf.ts refuses to run when CI is set.

Plan, still open: the reminder job (services/worker/src/jobs/sendReminder.ts) was made idempotent (sentAt check, conditional claim on claimedAt, idempotencyKey to the mailer), but it needs a new Prisma migration adding a nullable reminder.claimedAt column. The migration is not written yet; Jordan said later.

Worker queue concurrency is 5 jobs per process (WORKER_CONCURRENCY env var, services/worker/src/queues.ts). For the end-of-month reminder backlog the recommendation was to raise the max replica count (the worker autoscales on queue length) rather than raise per-process concurrency, since higher concurrency means more DB connections and mail sockets per process.

Jordan has a Django side project called trailmix (htmx forms, e.g. hikes app at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix). Fixed a double-post: a submit button had its own hx-post in addition to the form's, so only the form should carry hx-* attributes.
Invoice export CSV columns use snake_case headers; the amount column is now amount_cents (was amountCents), per finance. Anyone parsing the old header needs updating; worth a release note.

Exception tracking in acme worker: reportException() in services/worker/src/report.ts is a stub that only logs; the real tracker client is not wired because it is unknown which tracker Jordan uses. The render-pdf job now logs, reports and rethrows crashes (branch acme-388-render-pdf-crash-reporting, 4f2a9c1, not pushed).
Jordan's rule: no emojis in code, commit messages or docs (emojis were removed from services/worker/CHANGELOG.md).

acme-platform API rule: every table has an org_id column and every query must filter by org_id (req.auth.orgId); all route queries do. Invoice stats query was fixed for this. API JSON uses camelCase field names (e.g. totalCents) and SUM() results must be converted from DECIMAL strings to numbers.

acme infra is Terraform 1.8 in infra/terraform (aws provider ~> 5.60); the Pulumi stack was removed on 2026-08-26 (e40a7b9). Changes go through the CI plan/apply workflow, not applied locally. Buckets follow the pattern in s3.tf (acme-${var.env}-..., public access block, local.tags). Invoice exports bucket is infra/terraform/s3_invoice_exports.tf: private, objects expire after 90 days.
Public API rate limiting: apps/api/src/plugins/rate-limit.ts uses @fastify/rate-limit, 100 requests per minute per client IP, counted in Redis so all replicas share it, with /healthz exempt.
Jordan's preference: use the gh CLI for GitHub operations (issues, PRs). Issue #1318 tracks rollout of the invoice-exports S3 bucket.

Outgoing acme webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256 in the X-Acme-Signature header, format t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex> over '<timestamp>.<raw body>' (apps/api/src/webhooks/sign.ts). The dashboard webhooks settings page (apps/web/pages/settings/webhooks.tsx) was corrected from the wrong X-Signature/SHA-1 text.

The acme CLI reads its config (including webhookSecret) from ~/.acme/config.json, not from environment variables; `acme webhooks test` uses readConfig() and errors if webhookSecret is missing (set via `acme config set webhookSecret`). The web app is Next.js 13.5.6 with the pages router.

The worker image job (services/worker/src/jobs/processImage.ts) resizes uploads to thumb 160px, medium 640px and large 1600px wide (no upscaling), auto-rotates by EXIF, and writes WebP (quality 82) next to the original at <key>/<size>.webp; the original is kept. HEIC uploads (iPhone photos) fail in sharp; suggested fix is converting on the client or rejecting at POST /v1/uploads.

Running web e2e in acme-platform: start the dev server on port 3000 first (pnpm --filter web dev), then `pnpm --filter web e2e` (Playwright, optionally e2e/invoices). Known failure: invoices/detail.spec.ts 'downloads pdf' 404s because the seed invoice inv_e2e_1 has no pdfKey (fixture gap, also failing in nightly staging e2e); seeding a pdfKey was offered but not done.

Web auth provider in acme is Auth0 via @auth0/nextjs-auth0 (pages/api/auth/[auth0].ts, lib/session.ts, docs/architecture.md). next-auth in apps/web/package.json is an unused leftover from a Nov 2025 spike (0aa31f2); removing it was deferred ('later').

Open zod bump: deps-bot PR #1312 (zod 3.23.8 to 3.24.1, branch deps/zod-3.24.1). Five type errors from stricter inference were fixed and committed locally as a8c4f31 but not pushed; deps-bot will rebase and re-request CI once pushed.

Bug pattern found in acme web: setLoading(true)/setSubmitting(true) followed by an early return without resetting state leaves buttons spinning (fixed in ExportButton using try/finally). Two more unfixed instances: components/clients/ArchiveClientButton.tsx:18 (409 response) and components/settings/InviteMemberForm.tsx:31 (validation failure).

Added utilities/flags: parsePaymentTerms() in apps/api/src/lib/payment-terms.ts (net N for 1-365, 'due on receipt' = 0, throws InvalidPaymentTermsError otherwise; reviewer suggested optionally accepting a trailing 'days'), and `acme invoices list --json` which prints the raw array as pretty JSON for piping to jq.

ADR 0009 (accepted 2026-03-18): the acme web app does not use Redux. Server state stays in TanStack Query; small client state uses zustand stores colocated with the feature (e.g. useInvoiceEditorStore). Lena wanted Redux for the invoice editor; zustand is the answer.

Gotcha (docs/gotchas.md): Clerk dev keys (pk_test_) fail production builds, and preview deploys build with NODE_ENV=production, so they need the live publishable key. .github/workflows/preview.yml:41 wrongly passes CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY_DEV, causing 'Clerk: production build detected with development keys' on preview (seen on PR #4866 acme-412-invoice-editor-store). Fixing it needs platform team approval since it is under .github/.

Jordan's rule: icon-only buttons must always have an aria-label (and icon aria-hidden). UI conventions in acme web: use shadcn/ui components from apps/web/components/ui and lucide-react icons, not the hand-rolled icons. Other icon-only buttons in components/ still lack labels (sweep offered, deferred).

Branch acme-412-invoice-editor-store (zustand invoice editor store, with duplicateLine action and shadcn buttons) is pushed but no PR is opened yet; duplicateLine has no test, and the LineItemRow grid's last column (2.5rem) is too narrow for two icon buttons.

TypeScript path aliases in acme-platform: @acme/* maps to packages/*/src (tsconfig.base.json); use @acme/shared/... instead of deep relative imports like ../../../../packages/shared/src. The worker depends on @acme/shared as workspace:* so its tsup build resolves it.

acme CLI exit-code convention: exit 2 for usage errors (throw UsageError), exit 1 for runtime errors (EXIT_USAGE/EXIT_RUNTIME in packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts, mapped in index.ts). Bad args should print a one-line message, not a stack trace.

Jordan's standing rules: keep components small (under 150 lines) with colocated tests (the 400-line invoice editor will be split later), and before saying something is done, re-check the work for bugs and security issues.
